notes:
Founder-led discovery call (Alex Rivera, CEO) — 2026-03-01. 30m intro + use-case deep-dive. Currently prototyping a chat support assistant using OpenAI GPT-4o. Primary asks: transparent token pricing, per-request latency expectations, and a head-to-head on cost for embeddings. Wants an apples-to-apples comparison with OpenAI and Anthropic pricing (including streaming costs and per-token rounding).

Key metrics shared by founder:
- Peak concurrent requests: ~50 rps during marketing surges
- Steady-state: 3-6 rps
- Latency target: tail p95 < 300ms for short-turn chat (<= 128 tokens)
- Embeddings volume: 10M docs initial index, incremental monthly growth ~200k docs

Security: SMB but handling PII in support transcripts. Asks: SSO/SAML, audit logs, optional retention controls, and whether Redwood has a SOC2 report or equivalent.

Commercial: extremely cost-sensitive. Wants a simple billing model (flat per-token + predictable overage) to avoid surprises. Requested: 100k token trial credit for POC evaluation, and example invoices for 3 usage profiles (low, bursty, embeddings-heavy).

Founder quotes: "We need predictable unit economics — if the bill spikes we won't be able to justify it to investors."

Action items agreed on call:
- Jordan to send pricing calculator + sample invoices (by 2026-03-03)
- Priya to prepare quick perf benchmark on our hosted_api vs GPT-4o for a 128-token chat (note: include streaming vs non-streaming numbers)
- Alex to confirm POC window and provide a subset of docs for an embeddings cost sim (asks for NDA before data exchange).

Risks: Founder evaluating initially on price only; may default to OpenAI if numbers are close. Timing: wants decision within 6 weeks if POC looks good.
